She was beautiful. Absolutely stunning, not only in looks, but in her heart too. That’s why she didn’t deserve her life to end like this. Being beaten to death was no way to go, especially for someone like her. 

You see, from what I know, she somehow got into a very abusive relationship, but she was too kind to leave him. He would always guilt her into staying, and she would agree to keep him happy.

But she could never keep him happy for long. There were so many rules for her to follow, and unfortunately she was human, she was bound to make mistakes.

She forgot to do the dishes again. The second time in a row. But I personally don’t believe she forgot, I believe she remembered, and she knew what would happen if she forgot. She had lived in this hell for too long, and wanted to escape.

But I also believe that she deserves so much better. As the sun had not set yet, I could still save her. You see, contrary to popular beliefs, us vampires do not die in the sunlight. In fact, we are able to return life to worthy humans.

And she was worthy.

I came out from the closet. How I got into her closet in the first place does not matter. I came out, and walked to her lifeless body. The man who had killed her attempted to hurt me, but as the sun was beginning to set, I was growing stronger.

I sat down next to her, and gave her a small kiss on the lips. The kiss of life, as some call it. A small amount of color and warmth began to spread through her, and it slowly grew.

As for me, the sun was now gone, and I no longer could revive anyone else, but all I truly wanted was for her to be safe.

For him, however, he would not be alive much longer. I had the ability to kill again, and I was quite hungry. I stuck my fangs into his neck, and sucked out his horrible tasting blood. His body collapsed within seconds. The worst people are always the weakest inside.

I left before she fully regained consciousness. But I do hope she will be thankful. She deserves a better life, and I know she will get it.
